Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
henrik ericsson wrote:
> Is Psyche!+Mirror Image a valid combo? I thought that the new combat
> (from the Psyche!) didn't count as resulting from the acting minion
> being blocked and thus there is no action to continue and that you'd
> have to play Telepathic Tracking in order to get that combo working.
> Is it correct that you can play Mirror Image(or FoM or the other
> similar cards) to continue an action during a combat resulting from a
> Psyche!?

Yes, if you're the acting minion.
Mirror Image has no "in the resulting combat" restriction.
The action is still there to be continued.

> (Etrius + Protean Discipline + gets blocked: Earth Meld, Telepathic
> Tracking, Blood To Water, Form of Mist.)

Looks good.



Correct.

> > Mirror Image has no "in the resulting combat" restriction.
> > The action is still there to be continued.
>
> Is any of the current cards (Form of Mist, Chameleon's Color,
> Toreador's Bane) restricted in that way?
> I can't find any errata on them, but I might as well check...

None of the current strikes that end combat and continue the
action have a "resulting combat" restriction, no.

> I find this ruling to clash a bit with the ruling about Sniper Rifle
> and Psyche!
> (You can't set the range in the new combat) since Sniper Rifle does
> not have any restricting text about "the resulting combat", but I
> might be missing something here...

Sniper Rifle has a inherent "resulting combat" restriction:
"If the bearer blocks an action, he or she may set the range for the
first round of combat "

That either means "resulting combat" or "every combat the occurs
after this minion has blocked any action".

Obviously, the former is the correct interpretation.



Hm. Other than designer intent, I don't see why should any of these be
more valid:

- "... he or she may set the range for the first round of [the
resulting] combat"

- "... he or she may set the range for the first round of [every] combat"

- "... he or she may set the range for the first round of combat [during
that action]"

Many cards have implicit 'for this action' durations (most intercept and
stealth cards, for example), so that may even seem like the most logic
conclusion.

That just made me realize that Eyes of Night/Spirit's Touch by card text
seem to give a maneuver/press in any combat that occurs, and not only if
the block is sucessful. Which must be the reason for you to change the
text on Spirit's Touch for the CE :)

Flux
